summary.name: GNU Gatekeeper
summary.one_liner: GNU Gatekeeper (GnuGk) is a free H.323 VoIP gatekeeper for building VoIP or video conferencing systems.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes GnuGk as a VoIP gatekeeper for the H.323 protocol, offered as free software for building VoIP or video conferencing systems. It has a web interface (released December 2014) and a Nagios plugin for H.323 (February 2015). A Windows install video tutorial is linked. The latest listed release is GnuGk 5.16, dated 8 Oct 2026, with a Chinese translation of the manual available since May 2020. The page is a news and release log with little detail on specific features.
notable: Free H.323 gatekeeper software, originally OpenH323 Gatekeeper, first released about 20 years before June 2019
Includes a web interface and a Nagios plugin for H.323 monitoring
caveats: Page gives little detail on features or supported operating systems beyond Windows install instructions
Pricing is described as free in the meta description but no license terms are stated on the page
